description: This file contains pytest-based unit tests for the 'universalinit' Python project, specifically testing the SolanaNextJSTemplate integration, project initialization, configuration loading, template variable replacement, and post-processing scripts.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration object for the project, including project name, version, description, author, project type, output path, and parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration of different project types, including SOLANANEXTJS.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Contains information about environment setup commands, build commands, and other initialization details for templates.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Class responsible for initializing projects based on configurations and templates.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Class that provides templates given a directory.

classes.name: SolanaNextJSTemplate
classes.description: Template class for a Solana Next.js project, providing initialization info and template processing.

methods.name: test_nextjs_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Validates that the template's init info matches expected commands and data.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests the project setup process, verifying directory structure, file content, and variable replacements.

methods.name: test_parameter_defaults(template_dir, temp_dir)
methods.description: Checks that default parameters are correctly applied when none are provided.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Ensures that post-processing scripts are executed and their effects are present.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Verifies that project configurations are correctly loaded from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Checks that template variables in files are correctly replaced with project parameters.
